closer-to-heaven.title: Astrix feat. Michele Adamson – Closer to Heaven

clips.name: lazy-which-way-drop
clips.note: Unknown Reality – Which Way (track 4; in the mix about 13:28–18:53), kicks all the way through.

clips.name: lazy-new-moon-to-light-breakdown
clips.note: The end of New Moon (track 9, no published BPM) fades into Unknown Reality – Light (track 10, from about 47:08 in the mix); Light's kicks start at about 47:51.

clips.name: lazy-light-to-ring-of-clouds-transition
clips.note: Unknown Reality – Light (96) into Ring of Clouds (82, from about 54:07 in the mix). Light's kicks end at about 53:54; Ring of Clouds' kicks start at about 54:49 (69 s into the clip).

clips.name: lazy-frozen-to-earthbound-ambient
clips.note: The kicks of Driftsetters – Frozen (Unknown Reality Remix), 98 BPM, end at about 1:14:58 (10 s in); Earthbound starts beatless at about 1:15:25 and its kicks come back at about 1:16:35, just after the clip ends, so about 96 s pass without kicks.

clips.name: closer-to-heaven-breakdown
clips.note: Full-on psytrance. The breakdown runs from about 4:41 to 5:32 (a lone kick at about 4:53); the kicks come back at about 5:33.

clips.name: deep-jungle-walk-breakdown
clips.note: Darker, progressive psytrance. The kicks thin out from about 3:16, stop at about 3:25 and come back at about 3:37.

clips.name: singularity-drop
clips.note: Melodic techno, kicks all the way through.

clips.name: says-ambient
clips.note: Synth arpeggio and piano without kicks or bass (the bass comes in at about 3:58). Beatport lists Says at 150, 116 and 112 BPM on different releases, so no BPM is given.
